definitions.gloss: work of art; art object; artwork (esp. as an item)
definitions.explanation: An item recognized as a work of art — paintings, sculptures, ceramics, lacquerware, and the like. Treats the work as a physical object that can be owned, displayed, insured, or stolen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貴重|きちょう}→貴重：00223_kichou⟧な{美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We exhibit valuable works of art.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This artwork is from the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}→個人：02758_kojin⟧⟦{所有|しょゆう}→所有：12752_shoyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄贈|きぞう}→寄贈：12345_kizou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Privately owned works of art are sometimes donated to museums.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (fine art) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (article, item). Emphasizes the work as a tangible object, distinguishing it from ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧ (the activity/field of fine art).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧: art exhibition
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収集|しゅうしゅう}→収集：11829_shuushuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to collect art
- {美術品|びじゅつひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鑑定|かんてい}→鑑定：16030_kantei⟧: art appraisal
- ⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧な{美術品|びじゅつひん}: expensive artwork

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧: fine art — the field or activity, not the individual object
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: work of art — broader, includes music, literature, and performance
- ⟦{骨董品|こっとうひん}→骨董品：06990_kottouhin⟧: antique — older items valued for age as well as artistry
